subject: Private 3D case review portal for your oral surgery team?
body:
Hi Huntington Beach Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery team,

I'm Emmanuel, building MedViz, a browser-based 3D case review workflow for oral and maxillofacial teams.

I'm reaching out because your practice handles review-heavy oral surgery workflows, and I now offer MedViz as a private pilot setup for clinics that want a clearer way to review, annotate, measure, and share complex 3D cases in the browser.

The current MedViz setup supports browser-based 3D review, measurements, annotations, slicing, orientation and unit confirmation, and exportable review reports.

Live product:
https://medviz-web-editor.vercel.app/

If this is relevant, I can show you a short workflow demo and discuss a private pilot for your team.

Thanks,
Emmanuel
